title: Digital Arrest scam ka asli blueprint kya hai?
hooks: Digital arrest ka koi kanoon nahi — victims lost hundreds of crores.
Video call pe police wala darata kaise? Ek screenshot se bachav.
WhatsApp pe koi arrest nahi kar sakta. Par log dar ke paise kyun bhejte hain?
hook_why: Opens with the legal truth and the scale of losses (hundreds of crores) in one breath — immediate stakes, zero fluff, fits the 'High-Utility Evidence' hook pattern that wins on Shorts.
metaphor: A glowing red LOCK snaps shut on a smartphone screen (the fake 'digital arrest'); a single CAMERA SHUTTER click breaks the lock — the screenshot is the key.

caption:
Digital Arrest ka kanoon nahi — victims lost hundreds of crores. Scammer video call pe police banta, fake FIR dikhake 'safe account' mein paisa maangta. Ek screenshot (1930 pe bhejo) bacha sakta tumhara paisa. Kabhi OTP/PIN mat dena. Pehle ghante mein report karne se recovery ke chances badhte hain. Tune kabhi aisa call uthaya?

Education only, not financial advice.

claims.claim: Digital arrest is not a legal procedure in India.
claims.basis: Ministry of Home Affairs, I4C advisories; no provision in CrPC/IT Act for 'digital arrest' via video call.

claims.claim: Digital arrest scams have caused losses running into hundreds of crores, as per Ministry of Home Affairs advisories and media reports (2024).
claims.basis: Ministry of Home Affairs advisories and media reports (2024).

claims.claim: Scammers operate primarily from Myanmar, Laos, Cambodia.
claims.basis: MHA / I4C reports; multiple arrests and call-centre busts linked to these jurisdictions.

claims.claim: No genuine law-enforcement agency conducts arrest or verification via WhatsApp/video call.
claims.basis: Repeated advisories by Delhi Police, Mumbai Police, CBI, RBI, and I4C.

claims.claim: Reporting unauthorized transactions within 3 working days limits customer liability per RBI; immediate reporting on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in improves recovery chances.
claims.basis: RBI circular on customer liability (2017, updated 2021) for zero liability within 3 working days; I4C SOP for immediate reporting.

claims.claim: Never share OTP, PIN, CVV with anyone claiming to be police or bank official.
claims.basis: Universal banking safety rule reinforced by RBI, NPCI, and all major banks.

story_notes: scene 5: 'Majority of mule-account funds go to Myanmar/Cambodia' is wrong: While Southeast Asia is a major hub, no authoritative public data confirms 'majority' for all India cases; routing varie

yt.title: Digital Arrest Scam Blueprint Exposed – Save Your Money
yt.description:
Scammers pose as police on video calls, show fake FIRs, demand money to ‘safe accounts’.
Real police never arrest via WhatsApp; report within 1 hour on 1930 and to your bank.
Never share OTP, PIN, CVV – protect yourself from this growing fraud.
Digital Arrest Scam, Cyber Fraud, 1930 Helpline, Bank Safety, UPI Security, Scam Alert
